infos.title: Dress code
infos.text: Garden party. Heels and lawns don't mix: think block heels!

infos.title: Registry
infos.text: Your presence is the best gift. A honeymoon fund will be available on the day.

rsvp.title: Can we count on you?
rsvp.yesText: We can't wait to celebrate with you!
rsvp.noText: We'll miss you. Thank you for letting us know.

items.title: Auberge de la Forêt
items.text: A block of rooms is held for our guests until May 1st. Mention “Chloé & Nathan”.

items.title: Shuttle
items.text: A shuttle leaves the train station at 3:15 pm and brings everyone back from 1 am.

items.a: Your invitation lists everyone we’re expecting. Ask us if in doubt!
Of course. A kids’ corner with games and a babysitter is planned.
The ceremony moves into the barn. The party goes on!
